content.title: N2OFF, Solterra Brand Services Italy execute LOI for battery storage projects
content.summary: N2OFF (NITO) has signed a binding LOI with Solterra subsidiary, Soltera Brand Services Italy. According to the terms of the LOI the Projects will include the purchase and development of 2 Battery Storage systems in Sicily, each with a capacity of 98MWp/392MWh.
